title: Mastering Vehicle Wraps: Tips from the Pros
description: Industry veterans Tom Rodriguez and Lisa Park reveal their secrets for perfect vehicle wrap installations, from design considerations to avoiding common mistakes.
keyTakeaways: Proper surface preparation accounts for 70% of wrap longevity
Always design with 2-3 inches of bleed for complex curves
Post-heating is critical for long-term adhesion in recessed areas
The right tools can cut installation time by 40%
Climate-controlled installation environments reduce failure rates by 60%
